hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]]; then black --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --fix --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.env* ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: Refusing to edit .env files" >&2; exit 2; fi; if [[ "$FILE" == */vendor/* ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: vendor/ is a git submodule" >&2; exit 2; fi'
